build_d2go_train_loader: build a D2Go training data loader from a CfgNode config with an optional dataset mapper
build_weighted_detection_train_loader: build a weighted detection training data loader that balances dataset frequencies using repeat factors
build_mapped_train_loader: build a mapped training data loader that selects WeightedTrainingSampler or standard sampler based on config
get_sampling_probability_table: generate a tabulated sampling probability table showing dataset sizes, repeat factors, and sample probabilities
build_clip_grouping_data_loader: build a batched data loader for video clip training grouped by clip length across GPUs
